name: @lacspace/motiongfx
description: Animated news motion graphics as pure ffmpeg filters — lower-thirds (slide/wipe/pop) coloured by category and urgency, breaking stingers (drop-in bar, flash, blinking corner badge), a scrolling ticker, a brand sting clip (logo zoom/fade over brand colour), and auto-shorts (16:9 → 9:16 with blurred, dimmed fill) — all eased with time expressions, safe-area aware per platform preset, Devanagari-ready via your font. Plugs straight into @lacspace/montage chains and multi-cut. Deterministic, no AI tokens.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
